name: New York

jury_list.statute: N.Y. Judiciary Law 509(a): 'A record of the persons who are found not qualified or who are excused, and the reasons therefor, shall be maintained by the commissioner of jurors. ... Such questionnaires and records shall be considered confidential and shall not be disclosed except to the county jury board or as permitted by the appellate division.'
jury_list.holder: Commissioner of jurors (Judiciary Law 509(a)); the county jury board reviews determinations.
jury_list.use_restriction: 'Such questionnaires and records shall be considered confidential and shall not be disclosed except to the county jury board or as permitted by the appellate division.' (Judiciary Law 509(a)).

sources.cite: N.Y. Judiciary Law 510(1) (juror must be a U.S. citizen)
N.Y. Judiciary Law 509(a) (record of persons not qualified or excused, with reasons; confidential)

voter_file.who_may_get: Any person, by FOIL request to the county board of elections or the NYS Board of Elections Records Access Officer, with a written statement that the data will be used for an 'elections purpose'.
voter_file.permitted_uses: Election purposes only. Election Law 3-103(5): 'The information contained in the statewide voter registration list shall not be used for non-election purposes.' The State Board says 'elections purpose' has traditionally been read to include campaigning, voter outreach, fundraising and academic research.
voter_file.use_restriction: Election Law 3-103(5): 'The information contained in the statewide voter registration list shall not be used for non-election purposes.'
voter_file.penalty: Knowing and wilful violation of the Election Law not otherwise covered is a misdemeanor (Election Law 17-168); county FOIL forms apply this to 3-103(5).
voter_file.attestation_required: Statement that the information will be used for an elections purpose in compliance with Election Law 3-103(5).

sources.cite: NYS Board of Elections, FOIL Requests - How to Request Voter Registration Data
Ulster County Board of Elections FOIL request form (3-103(5) notice; 17-168 misdemeanor)

private_challenge.form_or_statute: N.Y. Election Law 5-220: affidavit delivered to the board of elections, oath read and signed before a board member; the board furnishes the forms.
private_challenge.deadlines: No filing deadline in 5-220. The board investigates; if it cannot decide before the next election, the voter goes on a challenge list to be challenged when voting (5-220(2)). The voter is notified by registered or certified mail within 5 days.
private_challenge.evidence_standard: Affidavit must recite the reasons and the facts supporting the belief, and state whether based on the affiant's personal knowledge or on information from another person; if from another person, it must name that person and the basis for that person's information. The board then investigates.
private_challenge.false_statement_penalty: Material false statement in a challenge affidavit is a misdemeanor (Election Law 17-108(2)).

county_board.name: County boards of elections (NYS Board of Elections county board roster)

state_election_office.name: New York State Board of Elections

ag.name: New York Attorney General - Election Protection Hotline complaint form
ag.note: The hotline is focused on voter protection. Election Law violations go to the State Board's Division of Election Law Enforcement (listed under other).

other.name: NYS Board of Elections - Division of Election Law Enforcement (complaints about possible Election Law violations, Election Law 3-104(3))

audit_path.statute: N.Y. Public Officers Law 87 (Freedom of Information Law) and 52 U.S.C. 20507(i) (NVRA public inspection of list-maintenance records)
audit_path.what_you_can_request: Counts only, from the county board of elections or the State Board of Elections: per year, the number of registrations cancelled because the registrant was not a U.S. citizen, and the number of Election Law 5-220 challenges filed on citizenship grounds and their outcomes.
audit_path.note: Do not ask for names. FOIL does not reach the courts: an 'agency' excludes 'the judiciary' (Public Officers Law 86(3)), so jury counts cannot be requested under FOIL. No New York statute sends juror citizenship answers to election officials.

gates.basis: Judiciary Law 509(a) makes the non-qualified juror records and reasons confidential. A private person cannot lawfully hold them, so no named leads exist and no challenge affidavit can rest on them. LEGAL-REVIEW.md item 4: NY primary mode is an audit of the official system with aggregate counts, not individuals.

notes: CHANGED 2026-10-07: applied under Optimus standing rule (no gate loosens). jury_list statute quoted exactly (Judiciary Law 509(a)); holder; use_restriction quoted exactly (same meaning); jury source 509 added; audit_path; federal_source_url moved to govinfo. official_pipeline stays null. No gate changes. No voter_file or private_challenge value changes. 2026-10-07 (Optimus final rulings, REQ-NOTE 65): voter_file.use_restriction added with the exact statutory text (copied from permitted_uses); the app shows it and requires the user's attestation before the voter file loads.

PA-style check: New York keeps the same kind of list as Pennsylvania ('A record of the persons who are found not qualified or who are excused, and the reasons therefor'), but 509(a) makes it confidential. public stays false.

NY primary mode (LEGAL-REVIEW.md item 4): aggregate audit of the official process. Example question for officials: how many jurors were disqualified for non-citizenship, and does any process compare them with the voter list?
FOIL: 'Agency' means a governmental entity 'except the judiciary or the state legislature' (Public Officers Law 86(3)); 'Judiciary' means 'the courts of the state' (86(1)). Verified 2026-10-07.
official_pipeline is null: no New York statute sends juror citizenship information to election officials. The NCSL table of jury-list pipelines (updated Sept. 1, 2026) does not list New York.
Cancelled-voter file: no published New York cancelled-voter file with a jury reason code was found. REQ-NOTE 27 drops cancelled rows before matching.
no_online_posting is null: no explicit posting ban was found; 3-103(5) bars non-election use. The app treats null as barred. JuryRoll never posts data in any state.

dob_in_public_file and registration_date_in_public_file are null: the file layout was not checked against an official source in this pass. In NY mode the voter file is not loaded for matching, so this has no effect.
state_extra_days 0 means Election Law 5-220 has no window that starts before the federal 90-day window. Other Election Law sections were not exhaustively reviewed.
Election Law 17-212 (NY Voting Rights Act) creates private liability for intimidation, deception or obstruction, assessed by effect (LEGAL-REVIEW.md). Not re-verified in this pass.
